title: Summary card shows only the summary: no model line, no version menu
description: User feedback on 2026-10-10: "I like the summary box we are having currently. But it is having some problems. 1) When we don't have the summary delete the text part where it says "Uses GPT-5.6 Luna with low reasoning" 2) When we have the summary, don't show the "Version 1 of 1" "GPT-5.6 Luna" "Low reasoning" "Oct 9 ..." stuff. It should be just the summary for now." The summaries API keeps its versions; the card shows the latest one.
acceptance_criteria: Given a ready paper without a summary, when the card shows Generate summary, then no 'Uses <model> with <effort>' text appears.

Given a paper with one or more summaries, when the card shows, then it shows the heading, the latest summary and its sources with Show full summary. There is no version menu, model name, reasoning effort or timestamp.
Given the codebase, when this lands, then the version menu, the selected-version state and any helpers only they used are deleted, with their tests. Helpers used elsewhere stay.
Given the existing card states (progress, failure, needs PDF, retrieving, blocked, earlier PDF), when they occur, then they behave as before.
test_cases: Summary card has no 'Version', model, effort or time text, and shows the latest summary when there are several.
verification: Red (before SummaryCard.tsx changed): `npx vitest run src/features/summary` -> Test Files 2 failed | 4 passed (6); Tests 3 failed | 21 passed (24). Failures: 'Given no summary yet, Then Generate summary shows with no model or effort line' (found 'Uses Luna with low reasoning'); 'Given no summary, When Generate summary is pressed ...' (found the Luna span); 'Given two summary versions, Then only the latest shows ...' (found the Version 2 of 2 button). Green: `npx vitest run src/features/summary` -> Test Files 6 passed (6); Tests 23 passed (23). `npm run check` -> exit 0: eslint clean, tsc -b clean, Vitest Test Files 91 passed (91), Tests 689 passed (689). `npm run build` -> exit 0. E2E specs (conversation, fulltext, local-models) were edited but not run; they need the live stack.
